lines.zh: 翅膀嗡嗡，绕着腐肉打转。
lines.en: My wings buzz in circles around the rotten meat.

lines.zh: 这条小路，我一天飞八趟。
lines.en: I fly this little path eight times a day.

lines.zh: 跟着尸体的味道走，不会迷路。
lines.en: Follow the smell of corpses and you never get lost.
Six legs are slow; the wings are quick.

lines.zh: 有僵尸在动，我就凑过去。
lines.en: If a zombie moves, I drift over to it.

lines.zh: 腐肉摊子在哪，我的航线就在哪。
lines.en: Where the rotten flesh lies, there my flight path goes.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，躲开鸟嘴。
lines.en: I skim the ground to dodge hungry beaks.

lines.zh: 这只僵尸的脖子，我盯很久了。
lines.en: I have watched this zombie's neck for a long while.

lines.zh: 翅膜每秒扇两百下，别数了。
lines.en: My wings beat two hundred times a second; do not count.

lines.zh: 阳光太亮，我往阴影里钻。
lines.en: The sun is bright; I duck into the shade.

lines.zh: 前面有只快倒的僵尸，我先等着。
lines.en: A zombie is nearly down ahead; I will wait.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，是因为你身上有味。
lines.en: I circle you because you carry a certain smell.

lines.zh: 这一圈，是巡逻我的饭桌。
lines.en: This loop is me patrolling my dinner table.

lines.zh: 落在木栅栏上，擦擦前腿。
lines.en: I land on the fence post and wipe my front legs.
I land a step before the carrion.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我停在水沟边。
lines.en: Wings folded, I rest by the drain.
shadows... I can't go back.
Which way was I going?

lines.zh: 影子比我走得快，可我先到。
lines.en: My shadow moves faster, yet I arrive first.
Don't rush me. This is fast.
I follow a stench forward.
Wind blows. I feel nothing.
I circle the carrion three times.
I walk through the ash on six legs.
Daylight... I hate daylight.

lines.zh: 有人在等我吗。大概没有。
lines.en: Someone waiting? Probably not.
There is still blood on the carrion; I land.
I circle the rotten smell three times.
Stopped here, rubbing my front legs together.
Folded wings still make a faint noise.

lines.zh: 我在等一只走不动的僵尸。
lines.en: I am waiting for a zombie that cannot walk.

lines.zh: 天冷了，我的动作会慢半拍。
lines.en: When it turns cold, I move half a beat slower.

lines.zh: 蛆在土里翻身，我听得见。
lines.en: I can hear maggots turning in the soil.

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇的下午，就是晒太阳。
lines.en: A fly's afternoon is just sitting in the sun.

lines.zh: 我数着草叶，数到第十七根。
lines.en: I count blades of grass, up to the seventeenth.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉，留到傍晚再吃。
lines.en: This bit of rotten flesh I save for evening.

lines.zh: 有人走过，风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: Someone passed by; the breeze knocked me sideways.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你有很多个影子。
lines.en: In my compound eyes you have many shadows.

lines.zh: 翅膀脏了，飞起来会打滑。
lines.en: Dirty wings make my flight slip.

lines.zh: 下界？听说那里我会变红。
lines.en: The Nether? They say I turn red down there.
The reek of rotten flesh beats any flower.
I perch on a gravestone and rub my forelegs.
Breathing... no longer needed.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了一件要紧事。
lines.en: I forgot something important.
The smell of rotten flesh guides me.

lines.zh: 有东西快死了，我去等着。
lines.en: Something is dying; I'll wait by it.
My compound eyes are full of broken light.
Worms turn in the soil.
Counting my ribs.
Sunlight warms nothing in me.

lines.zh: 你手上是不是拿过腐肉？
lines.en: Have your hands held rotten flesh lately?

lines.zh: 你眨一下眼，我看见了三次。
lines.en: You blink once; I see it three times.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我的翅膀经不起拍。
lines.en: Do not swat; my wings cannot take a hit.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，像一块好落脚的地方。
lines.en: Standing still, you look like a fine place to land.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，比腐肉淡一点。
lines.en: Your sweat smells fainter than rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 我落在你肩上，只歇一会儿。
lines.en: I will land on your shoulder, just for a moment.

lines.zh: 你身后那只僵尸，快撑不住了。
lines.en: That zombie behind you is nearly finished.

lines.zh: 抬头看我的时候，请别张嘴。
lines.en: When you look up at me, please keep your mouth shut.

lines.zh: 你身上没有伤口，真可惜。
lines.en: No wound on you; what a pity.

lines.zh: 你的影子够大，我能躲进去。
lines.en: Your shadow is big enough to hide in.
We met once, long ago.
Come closer. I can't see.
Why haven't you fallen yet?

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我最靠近。
lines.en: I'm closest whenever you blink.
Your name... it slips away.
I have landed on your eyelashes.
Your shadow is lovely.
There is a dead look in your eyes.
I circle around your head.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，快不行了。
lines.en: Your smell says you are nearly done.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了个口，飞不稳了。
lines.en: A hole in my wing makes my flight wobble.

lines.zh: 别拍，我这身板一碰就散。
lines.en: Do not swat; this body falls apart at a touch.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还剩五条。
lines.en: One leg is gone; five remain.
It hurts, but I still have to fly.
One slap and I was nearly gone.

lines.zh: 我的复眼花了，看你有重影。
lines.en: My compound eyes blur; you have doubles.
A wound like this heals in days.
I dropped to the ground and rolled over.

lines.zh: 别补第二下，我已经飞不动。
lines.en: Do not finish it; I can barely fly.
As long as my wings buzz, I am alive.
With two health, I can't take a hit.
Two of my legs are broken.
Back off. I'm warning you.
A little sting. I can still fly.
I hit the ground and flipped over.
Even my bones belonged to someone else.
Stop swatting me, it hurts.
Again. I can take it.
A corner of my thin wing is gone.
You've got strength.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我隔着墙都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell rotten flesh through a wall.

lines.zh: 那块肉放下，我马上下来。
lines.en: Set that meat down and I will come at once.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，是不是坏了？
lines.en: Is the thing in your hand spoiled?

lines.zh: 越臭越好，我的鼻子就爱这个。
lines.en: The stinkier the better; my nose loves it.
I circle three times because I am holding back.

lines.zh: 蛆虫的味道比腐肉更香。
lines.en: Maggots smell even sweeter than rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 再放一会儿，我还没吃够。
lines.en: Leave it out a moment longer; I am not full.

lines.zh: 你给的这一口，够我飞一整天。
lines.en: This bite you offer will carry me all day.

lines.zh: 我扑过去了，谁让你举着肉。
lines.en: I dive in; you were the one holding meat.

lines.zh: 腐烂的东西，对我是热饭。
lines.en: Something rotten is a hot meal to me.
Hear my teeth grind?
Hold still and let me take one lick.
That rotten flesh is waving at me.
I circle around your wound.
That hint of blood makes my head spin.
I land on a zombie's shoulder.
The living smell too strong.

lines.zh: 僵尸身上的味儿，我追着咬。
lines.en: I chase the smell on a zombie.
My fingers reach on their own.
Feed me and I'll follow.

lines.zh: 撞上我的翅膀了，让一让。
lines.en: You hit my wing; step aside.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你居然撞得到。
lines.en: I am this small, and you still managed to bump me.

lines.zh: 你走路带风，把我推了半米。
lines.en: Your walking makes wind and pushes me half a meter.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底离我只有一寸。
lines.en: Your sole is only an inch from me.
A bump is fine; my shell is soft.

lines.zh: 你膝盖碰到的，是我的翅膀根。
lines.en: What your knee touched is the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 我这身板，经不起第二次。
lines.en: This little body cannot take a second one.

lines.zh: 你后退半步，我才有路飞。
lines.en: Take half a step back so I have room to fly.
I was nearly pressed into a little flake.
Do not brush me away; my legs will snap.
Pain... still pain.
click... who bumped me?
Move. I'm covered in dirt.
One swat and I'm on my back.
Sorry. Was that right?
Steady. Don't tread on me.
My shoulder fell. Pick it up.
Kin? No. Not quite.
You have creased my thin wings.
I hit your hand and bounce off.

lines.zh: 你手里有腐肉，我们就能成对。
lines.en: Hold out rotten flesh and we can pair up.

lines.zh: 两只苍蝇的事，也要看肉。
lines.en: Even two flies need meat to agree.

lines.zh: 我闻到另一只的翅膀声了。
lines.en: I hear another pair of wings nearby.

lines.zh: 繁殖前先吃饱，这是规矩。
lines.en: Eat well before breeding; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我们会在腐肉上落下卵。
lines.en: We will lay our eggs on the rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 那只飞得慢的，我看上了。
lines.en: I have my eye on the slow flier over there.

lines.zh: 蛆是我们的孩子，别嫌它们。
lines.en: The maggots are our children; do not scorn them.

lines.zh: 你多喂一块肉，就多一窝蛆。
lines.en: One more piece of meat means one more brood.

lines.zh: 我的寿命短，得抓紧时间。
lines.en: My life is short; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 配对成功，我就绕着她飞。
lines.en: Paired up, I will circle her in flight.
Next life, I'll come sooner.
Two graves, side by side?
The moon knows I won't stray.
If only you were dead too.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会孵在尸身上。
lines.en: Our eggs will hatch in the corpse.

lines.zh: 婚戒戴不上，那就跟着你。
lines.en: A ring won't fit, so I'll just follow you.
Closer... no. Never mind.
I saved you half a grave.

lines.zh: 我们落在同一块腐肉上。
lines.en: We have landed on the same piece of carrion.
This body makes nothing.
I can drag this piece of rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 掉了的蛆，我一条条捡回来。
lines.en: I gather the fallen maggots one by one.
The scrap you dropped is mine now.

lines.zh: 太重了，我换六条腿一起抬。
lines.en: Too heavy; I will lift it with all six legs.

lines.zh: 捡到一小块皮革，也能吃。
lines.en: A scrap of leather I find is still food.

lines.zh: 这个东西比我的头还大。
lines.en: This thing is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我先搬走，回头再慢慢啃。
lines.en: I will carry it off and chew it later.

lines.zh: 地上有粒种子，也算收获。
lines.en: A seed on the ground counts as a find.
Carrying a maggot in flight makes my wings heavy.
Let go; this one is mine to haul.
Shiny things. I want them.
Smells like the living touched it.

lines.zh: 僵尸的味道，比什么都香。
lines.en: The smell from a zombie beats anything.
Is this for me?
I am clutching a scrap of dried skin.
Why am I taking this?
Will this buy me meat?

lines.zh: 这块骨头归我，你们慢用。
lines.en: This bone is mine. Enjoy the rest.
Take it home. Bury it.
This will cushion my eggs.
That zombie's skin is already loose.
It walks slowly, just right for a bite.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是快死的那只。
lines.en: I have chosen the one close to falling.

lines.zh: 有腐尸味的地方，就有我的猎物。
lines.en: Where the corpse smell is, my prey is.
Bite the neck first; it is softest there.

lines.zh: 你身边的僵尸，我接手了。
lines.en: The zombie beside you is mine now.
Its blood has stopped, but the flesh is warm.

lines.zh: 一群苍蝇都来了，我得快。
lines.en: The whole swarm is here; I must hurry.
I smell a freshly dead thing.

lines.zh: 目标找到了，就在那棵树下。
lines.en: Target found, right under that tree.

lines.zh: 它倒下去之前，我要先咬一口。
lines.en: Before it falls, I want one bite.
This zombie will not last the night.

lines.zh: 哪里烂了，我就往哪里去。
lines.en: Wherever something rots, I go.
I will follow until you drop.
Dead or alive, I come close.
Your walk is getting unsteady.
Your blood is pulsing under the skin.
That smell is someone near death.

lines.zh: 追上你只是时间问题，腐肉味太浓。
lines.en: Catching you is only a matter of time; the rot smell is strong.
There's meat tonight.
I have my eye on your neck.
I circle your head and wait.
I'll clean up that rotting smell for you.
Those eyes are mine.
The smell of rotten flesh — I land.
I'm on your back now, don't move.
Rotten flesh smells sweeter than flowers.
I fly close along its back.
It raises an arm; I slip under it.
Patience; let it fall on its own.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，它就少一分力气。
lines.en: Each bite takes a little strength from it.

lines.zh: 它拍我，拍不到这么小的东西。
lines.en: It swats at me but cannot hit something this small.

lines.zh: 我绕到它耳朵边，声音最大。
lines.en: I circle to its ear, where the buzz is loudest.

lines.zh: 一千口也咬不死，我就咬一千口。
lines.en: A thousand bites will not kill it, so I will bite a thousand times.

lines.zh: 它已经站不稳了，加点劲。
lines.en: It can barely stand; press harder.

lines.zh: 它的脚步乱了，我跟着乱。
lines.en: Its steps are clumsy; I follow clumsily.

lines.zh: 我落在它肩上，它没感觉。
lines.en: I land on its shoulder and it feels nothing.
It is nearly down; I wait for that bite.

lines.zh: 追了半里地，我还没吃饱。
lines.en: Chased it half a mile and I am still hungry.
I paused behind your ear.
I fly close beside you, silent.

lines.zh: 你歇下的地方，就是我的饭桌。
lines.en: Wherever you rest becomes my table.

lines.zh: 僵尸的味道，隔着林子都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell the zombie through the trees.
I am waiting for your second stumble.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我一路跟着。
lines.en: I follow the smell of carrion all the way.

lines.zh: 僵尸的味儿，我绕不过去。
lines.en: I can't resist the smell of a zombie.
Turn and look at me.
When you raise a hand, I rise a little.
Your warmth is dropping.
I haven't left you this whole way.
You can't outrun a pair of thin wings.

lines.zh: 别停下，我正落在你后颈。
lines.en: Don't stop — I'm landing on your neck.

lines.zh: 你身上那股味，隔远也闻得到。
lines.en: I smell that on you from far off.

lines.zh: 你身上有腐肉味，我就跟着你。
lines.en: You smell of rotten flesh, so I follow.
The smell of rot is getting stronger.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视野边上。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我在十步外就闻到了。
lines.en: I smell rot from ten paces away.
Bit through; its skin is like old cloth.

lines.zh: 这一口不大，但我咬了很多次。
lines.en: It is a small bite, but I have bitten many times.
My mouthparts are thin and seek the seams.
Hit bone; it grates on my mouth.
It twitched; I keep biting.
The blood has stopped, but I bite anyway.

lines.zh: 这一下，替我的同伙咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for the rest of my swarm.
Bite and pull back before I am crushed.
My teeth are tiny, but the wounds add up.

lines.zh: 它终于倒了，我落在上面。
lines.en: It finally fell; I land on it.
Perched on a zombie's back, I nibble.

lines.zh: 我落在僵尸肩上，咬一口。
lines.en: I land on a zombie's shoulder and bite.

lines.zh: 我在你伤口上又叮一下。
lines.en: I sting the wound again.
Not strong. Strong enough.

lines.zh: 我落在你的护甲上，有点滑。
lines.en: I landed on your armour and it is slippery.
My mouthparts are finer than a needle.
I bit you, just a little.
I spat acid on your hand.
Don't dodge. Hold still.
I love things that are nearly dead.
This bite landed on bare skin.

lines.zh: 我这么小，咬你也不疼吧。
lines.en: I am so small — my bite cannot hurt, right?
I come for the one already dying.
You missed, and I'm still here.

lines.zh: 这具身体只剩这个用处。
lines.en: This body is good for this.

lines.zh: 倒下的时候轻一点，我只有两点血。
lines.en: Fall gently; I have only two health.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道把我从卵里叫醒。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh woke me from the egg.

lines.zh: 我出生在一具没人收的尸体旁。
lines.en: I was born beside an unclaimed body.

lines.zh: 主世界的空气，又湿又暖。
lines.en: The overworld air is damp and warm.

lines.zh: 第一天，我就学会了绕圈飞。
lines.en: On my first day I learned to fly in circles.

lines.zh: 我破蛆而出，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I broke out of the maggot, wings still soft.

lines.zh: 这片草地，够我飞一辈子。
lines.en: This meadow is enough for my whole life.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，世界都是慢的。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the world was slow.

lines.zh: 有人在附近死了，我才来。
lines.en: I only come when something dies nearby.

lines.zh: 第一次扇翅，只飞了半米。
lines.en: My first wingbeat carried me half a meter.

lines.zh: 我闻见了这地方的气味，就留下。
lines.en: I smelled this place and decided to stay.

lines.zh: 土松了一块，我就钻出来。
lines.en: One loose patch of dirt, and I am out.

lines.zh: 有东西快死了，我闻得到。
lines.en: Something is dying; I can smell it.
Light too bright... stings.
I land on the rot and rub my legs.
Just landed, so first, find a corpse.
I rub my forelegs and take off.
I crawl out of the eggshell.
No living, no carrion either.
The smell of carrion drew me here.

lines.zh: 我落在刚断气的东西上。
lines.en: I land on something that just died.
First thing on waking: hunger.
There are a few bodies here.
Where should I go?
shadows... back again.
Fire curls my wings before anything else.
One touch of flame curls my thin wings.

lines.zh: 从三米高掉下来，壳裂了。
lines.en: Dropped three meters and my shell cracked.
I hit the ground with my wings still open.

lines.zh: 水滴裹住我，我喘不上气。
lines.en: A drop of water traps me; I cannot breathe.
Sinking... fine by me.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我飞出了好远。
lines.en: An explosion flung me far away.

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇被炸得翻了个面。
lines.en: One fly got flipped over by the blast.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，带走半片翅。
lines.en: An arrow grazed me and took half a wing.
That arrow pinned me to the wall.

lines.zh: 这股味道，让我翅膀发麻。
lines.en: This strange scent makes my wings go numb.
This taste... wrong.

lines.zh: 三天没腐肉，我飞得发虚。
lines.en: Three days without rotten flesh and my flight weakens.
Hungry... hungrier than usual.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我躲进树皮缝。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I hide in bark.

lines.zh: 雷一劈，我的翅膀都焦了。
lines.en: One bolt and my wings are singed.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no bottom below; I keep falling.
Falling. Still falling.
